text: 尽管你为偶像出了一笔不小的价钱，最终公布的报价却高得离谱，轻易超过你出价的两倍。沃伦先生仔细眯眼看着纸条，随后宣布这个惊人的价格和一个陌生的名字：“班尤。”穿橙色僧袍的僧侣收下雕像，脸上露出兴奋神色，周围响起困惑的低语。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 154
text: Though you put a sizeable bid in for the idol, a truly outrageous sum is called, easily twice what you offered. Mr. Warren squints hard at the paper before calling out the staggering price and an unfamiliar-sounding name: “Banyu.” Confused whispers break out as the orange-robed monk collects the statue with a look of excitement on his face.
